text:
Maya (Design): Pushed a tiny mock for a "priority heatmap" in the alert preview pane. Goal: show at-a-glance which channels take priority across rules + suppression windows. Figma: https://figma.redwood/priority-heatmap Ethan (PM): Nice. Key asks: (1) make copy explicit about timezones, (2) keep summary sentence short for busy on-call eyes. Rin (Frontend): Implementation idea: use aria-hidden on decorative cells and an offscreen summary paragraph that reads the important counts. Snippet: ```

Heatmap: 3 channels active, 2 silenced

``` Jon (A11y): Good. Also ensure color isn't sole indicator: include small icons (check, dash) and provide keyboard navigation through rows with `aria-posinset` values. Announce when the heatmap updates: "Heatmap updated: two channels moved to silenced." Ivy (SRE): Wanted: show last-evaluated timestamp and whether this view used live or draft rules. If a fallback was applied, show it in the summary line. Maya (Design): Updated mock: summary -> "Heatmap updated 024-06-22T09:41Z 024-06-22 local: 2 active, 1 silenced (fallbacks: email)". I'll swap color tokens for better contrast. preview-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.redwood/alerts/heatmap?branch=heatmap-compact Ethan (PM): Great. Let's ship behind a flag and include a short tooltip explaining icons.
